reviews.name: Jerry Spears
reviews.text: Good communication (and follow through) is key to a good experience with any company and Highlander was on top of that from office staff, estimator to project manager. The roofing crew was like a well oiled machine and I was impressed. Each one had a job to do and worked hard at his task. I was pleased with the finished product and very pleased with the quality of service. I highly recommend this company and will do business with them again. They set the standard after dealing with two other companies that left me less than satisfied with their service.

reviews.name: Teresa Meyer
reviews.text: Highlander went the extra mile in getting everything we needed done and at a fair price on a timely basis! They estimated our repair job on an unusual roof and submitted the report on a tight schedule and in great detail. When we scheduled the repair job, they worked with us so we could be there to see the work and handle any issues. The crew that arrived was courteous and efficient and work was done well and on a timely basis over 2 days. They left the job clean and neat and removed all debris. I would highly recommend Highlander for any roofing needs!

reviews.name: Ivan Prim
reviews.text: I view roofing companies with a bit of skepticism - you hear so many stories... But, we needed maintenance and some repairs to our metal roof so I talked to some neighbors and checked out some websites and was really impressed with the Highlandser website and subsequently with their very personable estimater so I chose them. Good decision / Great job. Totally satisfied that they did the right repairs at a fair price and did not do any unnecessary work. At one point, we had a bit of communication problem between the installer and the front office but they went out of their way to make sure that the job was done right and that we were completely satisfied with the completed work.

reviews.name: Judy Reynolds
reviews.text: I will tell anyone who needs a new roof to contact Highlander Building Services. They were so accommodating when I reached out to them about a new roof. I had set up another company to install the roof, but after 5 months of waiting, they still weren't going to do my roof for another 4 - 5 months! Highlander came out and gave me the estimate and set up my new roof for a few weeks out. They came in late January 2026 and installed my metal roof in 2 days. The supervisor kept me informed of everything they were doing, and all of the guys on the crew were very friendly and hard workers. I love my new roof!

reviews.name: Sheryl McEntegart
reviews.text: Very professional. Miquel and Issac kept things going smoothly. The project exceeded my expectations. Would highly recommend.

reviews.name: al stephens
reviews.text: I highly recommend Highlander Building Services. Recently, I contacted them and two other companies to replace 3, 30 yr old velux roof windows. One of the companies wanted to charge me to provide a quote, the other's quote was twice the cost of Highlanders and not detailed. Highlanders' quote was a formal proposal complete with all of the information I needed to make an informed decision. Between confirming their selection to do the work and construction, their communication with me was timely and complete. The construction crew and foreman were all very professional, polite and got the job done in a day. I look forward to utilizing their services again in the future.

reviews.name: Glen Babcock
reviews.text: New roof and gutter guards. Efficient sales and contracting process. Professional hard working teams (sales, office, site management and crew). Made an expensive project a worry free one. Good cleanup too!

reviews.name: Airstream In the Mountains
reviews.text: We got 3 bids to repair a leaking roof from a bad install on a four year old house. We had a lot of discussions with Highland about what to do and they were very consultative so we chose them and we are glad we did! The install team with Stephen Preston was consensus and detailed. It’s a relief to know we now have a solid product and a company that stands behind it. Thank you to the Highland Team! We highly recommend!

reviews.name: Ray Harvey
reviews.text: Great experience with Highlander Roofing. From the initial contact to the final pickup of debris, the company is first class. The communication by every person involved with my metal roof replacement was fantastic.

reviews.name: William McMurry
reviews.text: They are truly professional in all respects. I have two homes on my property and they replaced one roof and corrected errors on the other roof due to poor workmanship of the previous roofer. They left me with much comfort that I was not going to have any problems in the torrential rains we get. Recently I had them replace three skylights and they were perfect.

reviews.name: Beth Schumacher
reviews.text: The team at Highlander Roofing is exceptional,! They are courteous, professional, and easy to work with! The whole team communicates well, works well with Insurance companies and gives you a high quality product!! We have worked with Highlander Roofing up in Franklin North Carolina, twice in the last five years. One was a new roof due to age, the second had to do with multiple trees falling on the roof .. a huge project! We would highly recommend them for any roofing job!

reviews.name: Brenda Williams
reviews.text: We were at our vacation home and a limb went thru our 2 year old roof. Within 36 hours of me calling them, Highlander came and assessed the damage, gave us a written quote and had it fixed. While I don’t think that experience is necessarily the norm, but the fact that they went out of their way to help, knowing we lived in Florida full-time and had it fixed before we had to leave to go back home meant a lot. These are quality professionals with the BEST customer service I’ve experienced in many years! You can’t go wrong calling Highlander!!!

reviews.name: Claire Proctor
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Highlander Roofing. They were very responsive, showed up when they said they would and did great work fixing the gutters on my house. Very professional and appreciate how easy they were to work with!

reviews.name: James Williams
reviews.text: I Had some roof and siding damaged by falling tree limbs and gave Highlander a call for a repair quote and they came out super quick to check it out and gave me a very reasonable quote and were going to be able to get the repairs done several weeks sooner than the first company estimate I got. They finished the repairs and it looks seamless and I couldn’t be happier with the work!

reviews.name: Joseph Dzielak
reviews.text: Gentlemen came out promptly for a detailed knowledgeable estimate. Crew arrived shortly after to perform the repair and worked quickly to replace any damaged sheething along with color matching the existing shingles. Site was cleaned up nicely with tarps used to catch the mess. They didn't leave a nail behind. Roof looks good and no longer leaks. Thank you for a job well done at a fair price. I would definitely recommend this company.

reviews.name: Don Mathews
reviews.text: We are in our second year of working with Highlander and could not be more pleased. They do an incredible job at a fair price and are totally professional Their people are second to none and represent them well. I highly recommend their services

reviews.name: Marilyn Waylen
reviews.text: We recently had a beautiful and affordable, blue metal roof installed by Highlander Roofing. There’s nothing like a new roof to give a place a facelift! Our property value has increased in one smart move! The team was friendly and professional. The job was done in a day and the only evidence that they were here at all is our gorgeous roof! All scrap and debris was carted away. The entire process has been a genuine pleasure! Thank you!

reviews.name: David Christopher
reviews.text: We are very pleased with the new roof and new gutters that Highlander installed on our cabin. Everyone was very nice and even with all the recent rain, completed our work in timely fashion .

reviews.name: phil mccullem
reviews.text: Excellent service. On time and on budget. They will be doing my other roofs shortly. No problems at all. If need be check other roofers, then call Highland Roofing.. Or save time and frustration and call them first. Fair and honest.

reviews.name: B Cook
reviews.text: Highlander Roofing has been very helpful for multiple years with gutter cleaning, roof cleaning & roof repairs on our high & steep roof. Workers stay safe & always have great attitudes & work ethics. Thanks Highlander. We hope to see you again next Spring.

reviews.name: Joseph Capita
reviews.text:
Our roof suffered wind damage.
Highlander repaired the roof on time and within the budget estimate.
We cannot recommend Highlander highly enough.

reviews.name: Tom Foley
reviews.text: We had a couple of skylights replaced by these guys and they did a great job. All the stuff you hope for - professional salespeople and crews, they showed up on time and did what they said they were going to do with no surprises.

reviews.name: Tom Mere
reviews.text: They were on time, did a great job, cleaned up good, and the price was fair. What more could you expect. Thanks Highlander Roofing.

reviews.name: Donna martin
reviews.text: After seeing what my roof looks like I wish I could get them to do the whole thing. They where on time and cleaned up behind themselves. They also cleaned my gutters. I would recommend them to anyone.

reviews.name: mike bryan
reviews.text: First, I did a lot of work to find not just the right company, but, even more importantly, the right person. I relied on referrals, reviews, real estate agents…..I even contacted the Better Business Bureau. After several interviews I found Luke Smith at Highlander Roofing Services in Franklin, North Carolina. Our home had been heavily damaged from Hurricane Helene and we could no longer live in it. So, a ten hour round trip meant…….I have to rely on other's. Luke was that guy. So much damage was not observable until the old roof was disassembled. He helped us in so many ways……even driving to us with some larger metal samples. The constant stream of photographs with notes…..really eased the stress level. Even if I been standing there…….there is nothing I could have added. Luke’s crew are professionals…..there is a project manager ( a very sharp guy)………I’m convinced they left no stone unturned. For a job like this, I think it’s crucial to have crystal clear communication…….and Luke excelled at that. My neighbors are certainly impressed with the outcome. Anne and I could not be happier……from beginning to end. Thank you to Luke Smith….and his team at Highlander Roofing Services.

reviews.name: Sherri Potter
reviews.text: Fast service for minor repair to metal shed roof. Price was reasonable.

reviews.name: Bill King
reviews.text: Couldn't have been a better experience , professional all the way from the estimators to the application of the roof. My yard was left in better shape than when the crew got there.

reviews.name: Amanda Vernon
reviews.text:
After a tree strike slammed completely through the ridge of my detached garage and broke several trusses, I reached out to three different roofing companies. Highlander Roofing Services was the only one that actually showed up for the appointment and provided a solid quote. We signed the agreement, and within just a few weeks, they had a crew out tearing off the old roof.

They discovered a lot more wood damage than expected, but the team handled it quickly and professionally. By the afternoon, the entire job was done and I had a brand new roof. The whole process was smooth, efficient, and exactly what I needed after the stress of the initial damage. Highly recommend Highlander for anyone needing quality roofing work done right.

reviews.name: Ed Shatley
reviews.text: Work was done in a professional manner, on time, and follow-up for correctness. There was a change which needed to be made and this was done, again timely, and correctly

reviews.name: Craig Lake
reviews.text: Many companies can put on a roof, Highlander Roofing makes the experience a pleasure. The office staff made us feel as though we were friends rather than clients. We had a small problem with the color of the drip edge that was discovered on installation day, the production manager resolved the issue immediately. The installation crew was very professional and did a wonderful job including sweeping the yard and driveway with magnets to ensure no roofing nails were left behind. I recommend Highlander without reservation.

reviews.name: Jaden Faith
reviews.text: This is the best company I have ever worked with. They came out met with me several times they were flexible. They worked around my schedule. I had a claim through my insurance. They worked with me step-by-step through the claim. They were very nice. They explained everything clearly I understood what was going on. I didnt personally know nothing about Roofing, but they made sure I understood what had to be done through the entire process. They were easy to get a hold of and this is the best company I have ever had to work with. I am so grateful that they came out and helped me. I highly recommend this company.

reviews.name: Anita Greiner
reviews.text: Very professional gutter repair and addition. They are busy but were able to get the work done.

reviews.name: Jerry Brooks
reviews.text:
When we realized the 20+ year old roofs of our house and separate workshop needed to be replaced, we interviewed two roofing companies. Following Braden's presentation, we were convinced that we were totally comfortable ONLY with Highlander. Braden did a wonderful job presenting the options for our roofs, and his professional style and thorough description of how the project would be handled, made selecting Highland for this project an easy choice! And we were not disappointed.

This large project was completed in 3 days, and there is not one aspect of this project that was not done to perfection. Javier, owner of the company performing the work, was an excellent supervisor of his work crew. All members of the work crew did a great job. In the course of the work none of our plants were damaged, and they did a very thorough job cleaning the property of debris and nails before they left. And the final result was examined carefully by Joel, Highlander's supervisor. Grade A++.

We would highly recommend Highlander Roofing to anyone needing a roof replacement. We have encountered few companies and contractors who perform at their level.

reviews.name: George Sistrunk
reviews.text: Responsive, on time, and did great work! I would definitely use them again.

reviews.name: Lorrie Contino
reviews.text:
We had a gutter leak and needed a downspout on the second story of our home. Highlander roofing came out quickly, quoted us a fair price and then installed the gutter soon after. Everyone we've dealt with has been kind, professional and
knowledgeable. We will absolutely use them again and recommend to anyone needing work done!!

reviews.name: Ali Richter
reviews.text:
Occasionally you come across a business or persons that are not only great but EXCEPTIONAL. Highlander Roofing is that company. We talked to 3 people and chose Highlander and I could NOT be more thrilled with the decision.

From our first meeting with the owner, communication with the office staff, and then the outstanding and professional crew who did the installation, the whole experience was such a positive one.

And let’s be honest - making such an huge and expensive decision - like a new roof - can be very nerve wracking, overwhelming and daunting. From the first introduction through to the end it’s been such a positive experience.

reviews.name: MoveStrong
reviews.text: Thanks for the great communication and work done! Will use again!

reviews.name: Palmira Snape
reviews.text:
The entire project of placing a new roof was excellent. From time a call was placed, during Helene, the inspection, ordering roofing material and transporting to our home at 4,100 feet We could not believe how smoothly such a difficult task was tackled. The placement of roof and clean up was completed in half day! This was a highly professional job and I would recommend their work with enthusiasm.
PSS ,Fines creek area,NC

reviews.name: Bill Vaughters
reviews.text:
Our house had a leak in our roof over our garage. I didn’t know who to call but came across Highlander’s name while on the internet. I called to see if they could take a look. They came out promptly and gave us an estimate which we accepted and scheduled. It was scheduled quite a way out as they were pretty busy. To our surprise they called and came out much earlier and did the work. We found them to be professional, responsive, reasonable and we highly recommend them.

We recently used them again to replace the roof on a cabin on the same property. Both times the jobs were handled promptly and professionally. Any questions we might have had were also handled in a friendly and professional manner.

We would use them for any future jobs and would highly recommend them to others.

We did use them again, to replace a roof on a cabin on the same property. We have used Highlander Roofing twice. Both times the jobs were handled promptly and professionally. Any questions we might have had were also handled in a friendly and professional manner.

We would use them for any future jobs and would highly recommend them to others.

reviews.name: Ken Lamb
reviews.text: Very professional. Quality of work was excellent and completed in a timely manner. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.name: Brett Swainston
reviews.text: It took a minute to get them here to start the project because of the crazy weather we had. As soon we had a solid start date the crew was here by 7am and had torn off the old roof and installed the new metal roof within a day. They were professional and did a great job cleaning up after. Highly recommend them if you need a new roof

reviews.name: Rebecca Sexton
reviews.text: Highlander did an excellent job at replacing the old roof. Since the roof had a leak, they worked us in at an earlier time than the date they had at first anticipated. They completed the work quickly and did an excellent job. All the staff are very professional and courteous with good follow-up after the job was completed.

reviews.name: Willard Armes
reviews.text: Having discovered a leak over a stormy week end, I left a request for assistance by message at Highlander Roofing. Within the next couple of hours, I received a response letting me know that an emergency crew would be responding to “tarp” the leak while awaiting roof repair. As promised, a professional crew responded and immediately stopped the leak. Within the next three weeks, I had a new, professionally looking roof installed at a reasonable price. Outstanding service and my sincere thanks to the entire Highlander Roofing Team!

reviews.name: Rick Eichman
reviews.text: Very professional and would and have recommended to my friends..

reviews.name: Chuck
reviews.text: Our HOA members went with Highlander and could not be happier. I dealt with Mathew Cannzone from start to finish. He checked in everyday to make sure we were happy with the progress and explained every step. The crew worked 2 long days ( 12 hrs each day) and got the 8 units done in 2 days, then spent HOURS cleaning up to make sure there were no nails and no debris. The roof looks wonderful. Highly recommend them!

reviews.name: Randy Campbell
reviews.text: Workmanship was great. Very accommodating customer service representatives. All went very well.

reviews.name: John Fairchild
reviews.text:
We had a tree fall and damage our roofing and gutters. After meeting with several contractors, we settled on Highlander Roofing. Other than an extended wait due to weather and other issues, our repairs were completed in a very professional and detailed manner. The repair team accidentally broke some cheap bird feeders we had up but without even asking, they went and bought us new feeders to replace the old ones, which I felt was above and beyond what they needed to do.
I highly recommend this company for their professionalism and quality of work.

reviews.name: Ruby
reviews.text: I highly recommend Highlander Roofing Company for any roofing needs. They responded to my call right away and sent someone to address my needs. They provided a timely service estimate at a fair price and followed up with repairs in an expedient and professional manner. Their customer service is top-notch, and they provide the most efficient and economical plan for your situation without overcharging or suggesting unnecessary expenses. I will continue to use Highlander for all my roofing needs. Do not hesitate to contact them immediately if you need roofing help!

reviews.name: jon cockes
reviews.text: Did what was needed and fixed something extra at no cost! The best roofing experience possible!

reviews.name: Stephen Walker
reviews.text:
A very responsive company! An estimator was at my home within a week of my call and showed up on time. Matthew had a price to me within 24 hrs and I went with them immediately. My project was special since I was doing the structural work and supplied most of the materials. They had the opportunity to charge me extra for some materials unmentioned in the estimate by didn’t ( very fair)
They charged me a fair price for some extra sheeting that came up.
The roofing crew was hardworking and cleaned up very good each day.
The gutter crew did a great job as well.
I highly recommend this company, a well run honest outfit.

reviews.name: Mark Shea
reviews.text: The staff at Highlander was very professional and was able to get me a roof inspection appointment very quickly. Thank you for all your help.

reviews.name: Steve Yust
reviews.text: Everyone showed up on schedule and worked till about 4 when they took a lunch break. They did a super job. I'm glad I chose Highlander. I don't think there's any roofing issue they can't handle.

reviews.name: Nanette Challenger
reviews.text: Squirrels had chewed into the edge of my roof and were in the attic, and Highlander replaced all the wood along the roof line and repaired everything, and they did a wonderful job, it looks beautiful now!!! The guys who did the repairs were very nice as well! I would never go to anyone else for roof repairs, Highlander is the best!

reviews.name: Rob Donoghue
reviews.text: Highlander did a good job on my new metal roof installation. They were responsive and accommodating in the bid process, generally showed up on time for the work, and completed the job on a timely basis, leaving the job site clean. The cost was reasonable based on other bids.

reviews.name: Den F
reviews.text: I could not be happier with my experience with Highlander Roofing . They were: pleasant, professional , returned calls, showed up when scheduled and BONUS did a great job putting on our new roof.They did a great clean up afterwards and were available to discuss the job. I highly recommend them for your roofing needs! Great job by all!

reviews.name: Brandon McMahan
reviews.text:
This company does good work. Their representatives are friendly and professional, and they leave the work site clean. Even their physical showroom is clean, comfortable, and inviting.
The first time I called them for roof repairs, they took dozens of photos and took the time to completely explain to me what was wrong, and how they would fix it.
I would highly recommend this roofing contractor to anyone.

reviews.name: Blake Rudeseal
reviews.text: Highlander Roofing replaced our old roof for us. Deven came out to give us a quote and he was very friendly and informative. They were on time with their arrival to do the job. Their price is on the high side compared to their competitors but this seems to be justified by the quality of materials used as well as their timeliness and professionalism. There was a small communication hiccup, but Shanna and her team went out of their way to make it up to us. Based on their response it seems that communication is generally a top priority for them. I would highly recommend Highlander Roofing Services!

reviews.name: Dawn and Jon Kluver
reviews.text: We used Highlander to sheathe and replace existing metal on a bardominium we are building. The team was absolutely fantastic! They were fast, clean, and kind. From estimate to finished product, Highlander was awesome. Thank you!

reviews.name: George Williams
reviews.text:
Highlander Roofing did an excellent job on my gutter cleaning, gutter installation, flashing, and roof repair. They handled every issue professional and the pricing was very fair. I would certainly use their services again and highly recommend them.

Hamp Williams

reviews.name: Linda Macapayag
reviews.text: My chimney sleeve was blown off my roof during a bad storm. Plus, I had a few roof leaks over my back patio. They were able to repair and reuse / reattach the sleeve (without having to buy a new one) and patched the roof in the spots needed. They saved me by not having to replace the whole roof. Professional, efficient and friendly service. Highly recommend them!

reviews.name: Rick Ford
reviews.text:
Professional. We were really impressed with Highlander roofing. From getting our estimate to project completion they kept us informed along the way. After paying 50% upfront, they let us know we were a some weeks from getting the roof on. During this period they remained in contact with us. They let us know when the materials were coming in.

The crew was wery careful in removing the old roof. They told us to keep our dog in to avoild any nails on the ground. When they finished for the day, they told us it should be OK to let our dog out as they had used a magnetic roller to catch any stray nails. Upon completion, another employee came and picked up the dumpster. He moved the dumpster down the drive and again went over the area with a magnet. He also used a drone to take pictures of the finished roof which were sent to us. If you need a roof, go here.

reviews.name: Troy Rice
reviews.text: HRS was great to work with. When I saw the final product I was blown away at how pretty it all looked. Would highly recommend them to anyone.

reviews.name: Carol Shuttleworth
reviews.text: I contacted HIGHLANDER Roofing for an estimate for a new roof. Josh Cornwell came out to the house that morning, checked out and measured my roof, and I had the estimate that afternoon. While they were not the lowest estimate they were in the ballpark and I was very impressed with their promptness and attention to my needs. They came out and put a tarp over my roof to stop the leaking while waiting in line. The roofers were prompt, professional and very friendly. They cleaned up the yard every evening before leaving and finished the job in three days. I would definitely recommend them and would use them again. And, by the way, the roof looks great! I am very pleased!

reviews.name: Matt Dale
reviews.text: Great service and timely communication! I highly recommend

reviews.name: Corol Conlin
reviews.text: These men are truly great! They were professional and went above and beyond what was expected. The roofers knew their trade and the man who performed work on my chimney seemed to know what he was doing as well. Two inspectors came out at various times to oversee the work. I am very happy with everything.

reviews.name: KAREN Williams
reviews.text:
I would like to begin by saying what an awesome experience I have had with Highlander Roofing and their courteous, kind, respectful and hard working staff that replaced the plywood and shingles and much more that is attached to the house but I am not sure of the spelling for the extra things that they replaced. Heck they even to extra time to replace that new wood that was removed and replaced.
I would like to give a special "shout out" to the translator that was with the group of men, Jackie is her name. What an angel she was!
I would reccomend Highlander roofing to anyone, especially if you want a job done right.

Sincerely Karen

reviews.name: Dynamic Advertising
reviews.text: Professional, friendly service. Extremely satisfied with finished product.

reviews.name: Tom Scott
reviews.text: Highlander Roofing replaced all the screws in the metal roof of our cabin near Lake Toxaway, NC. They removed an old wood-burning stove chimney and replaced the roof panel. In addition, they relaced the gutters and installed leaf shields. Their crews were personable and told us what they were going to do. They did a good cleanup when the work was done. In addition, Anna kept in touch with us as weather and scheduling changed the plans.

reviews.name: Viola Sharpe
reviews.text:
Cole made me feel that I could trust him & the complete process of my roofing. What I liked most of all was Cole kept me informed on the status of my roof from beginning to the end. He gave me hope because my insurance company was quite challenging. He worked hard for me.
He answered my questions & responded in a timely manner.

reviews.name: Erik Monsrud
reviews.text: We opted for the shingle roof. Josh came out and gave an estimate. It included metal and shingle roofs and other additional upgrades and options. The estimate was very thorough and was exactly what the project ended up costing us. And the quality of work is out of this world! I would recommend them over and over again. All of the staff at their sales office are super friendly and knowledgeable with samples of all their products and upgrades in the show room. I don’t have any other offers to compare their prices to but the cost seemed very fair for the high quality of work done. I would highly recommend them.

reviews.name: Nate Yoder
reviews.text: We contracted Highlander Roofing to replace our existing shingle roof with new metal roofing. They did a great job and kept us updated throughout the process. We would highly recommend them.

reviews.name: Patricia Sandusky
reviews.text:
Great service, and promptly repaired the problem.
The men worked constantly while there, and needed no supervision.

reviews.name: modegolf
reviews.text: Highlander Roofing is filled with great people. From my first call, to the first visit, and the final job, everyone was super kind and helpful. I highly recommend this company to anyone needing roof help!

reviews.name: Cindy Porter
reviews.text: Excellent service from my first contact at the office, inspection & estimate, updating me on status delays because of weather. The crew that came to clean & treat my roof plus seal the seams on my porch roof were courteous, prompt, and thorough. The guys even removed a very large limb from my carport & fixed the dents.

reviews.name: kent olsen
reviews.text: I called for a repair they showed up when they said for the estimate which I thought was very reasonable and actually called me to see if they could come earlier then scheduled and completed repairs and I was very happy with the work

reviews.name: Guzzy and Stench
reviews.text: Very professional and courteous, excellent work at a fair price. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Scott Manshack
reviews.text: Highlander Roofing Service has always done a great job for my insured’s. Everyone you deal with is very professional and knowledgeable. I recommend Highlander Roofing Service to anyone. New construction or repairs.

reviews.name: Aaron Lee
reviews.text: This company is top-notch! Trying to find a roofing company in this area of the state to actually answer the phone is very difficult. Thankfully, Highlander Roofing was very responsive. I can't thank them enough. The quality of work is top notch and their fees are fair.

reviews.name: Daniel Jenkins
reviews.text:
Highlander employees were very personable and professional. They explained the issue, repaired the roof and offered suggestions for continued maintenance.
I am pleased with the service.

reviews.name: Gary Howard
reviews.text: HRS was very professional assessing issues with the flashing on our roof, staying in touch while scheduling the work and following up with pictures of the completed project. Excellent quality and everything was thoroughly cleaned-up at the conclusion.

reviews.name: Teresa Wolfe
reviews.text: My mom's gutters needed to be replaced. From the assessment to the work crew. Everything was smooth sailing. The work crew was very knowledgeable and did a wonderful job. Thanks so much!!!!

reviews.name: Richard Hotaling
reviews.text: Good job replacing old damaged gutters with new gutters that matched our house.

reviews.text: Very prompt, excellent work very satisfied

reviews.name: John and Janie Smith
reviews.text: Highlander Roofing was professional, timely and helpful. They did a great job on our roof replacement and gutter installation.

reviews.name: Deborah Beck
reviews.text: Amazing service! Highly recommend. They repaired my 108 yr old home, ran into another problem & they made it right! They WILL be my next roofer when the time comes!

reviews.name: Zary M
